subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost adopt the fixed 30-second opening-handshake cutoff despite the possibility of rejecting unusually slow but eventually successful proxy or server upgrades?
rationale: The implementation and dependency contract are clear, but choosing the fixed availability tradeoff remains a maintainer-owned merge decision that CI cannot settle.

options.title: Accept the fixed 30-second budget
options.body: Land the narrow timeout aligned with existing WebSocket clients and keep the configuration surface unchanged.

options.title: Require an operator-tunable budget
options.body: Pause the PR and add configuration only if maintainers have evidence that legitimate Mattermost deployments need longer opening handshakes.

recommendation.title: Accept the fixed 30-second budget
recommendation.body: Land the narrow timeout aligned with existing WebSocket clients and keep the configuration surface unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The reconnect implementation this timeout feeds into appears to originate with this owner.
